We need to get a wot of heavy damage to take down this swow but menacing foe. ☒☒⌐■-■☒☒|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 10 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Fallen]])}} |-|Version 1= {{QuoteBox|Incoming boss!|Beginning of Wave 10 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Abnormal Boss''' is a large [[Enemies|enemy]] that is the first (non-major) boss to appear in [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode and [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, alongside a few challenges. The '''Abnormal Boss''' is slightly faster than the [[Heavy]]. Outside of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, the '''Abnormal Boss''' has been completely replaced by the [[Elite Abnormal]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Abnormal Boss''' has a reflective light green skin color and a black diamond-plated torso and legs. It has one pair of grey chains wrapped around its left arm, three pairs around its right arm and a pair wrapped around its torso. The '''Abnormal Boss's''' face has two scars, which forms an "X" on its face. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The [[Enemies Beta]] version of the '''Abnormal Boss''' is a humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a dark green skin color and a dark greyish-blue torso and legs. Veins can be seen on its arms and head and it has no face. It also wears black armbands with grey spikes on them. |Version 2 |The second version of the '''Abnormal Boss''' had a reflective light green skin color and a magenta granite torso and legs. It had one pair of grey chains wrapped around its left arm, three pairs around its right arm and a pair wrapped around its torso. It also had a drooling zombie face with glowing magenta eyes. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Abnormal Boss''' had a salmon skin color, a brown pebble torso with tumors and darker brown pebble legs. It also had a drooling zombie face with glowing red eyes. }} ==Strategy== *The '''Abnormal Boss''' has much higher health than the enemies that make their debut before it, along with defense. Thus, it is recommended to invest in additional defense before its debut. *Most towers that have a sizeable DPS can deal with the '''Abnormal Boss''' quite effectively. **Almost any tower catered towards early game, like the [[Ace Pilot]], [[Gladiator]], [[Golden Scout]], [[Militant]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] is recommended. **Stronger towers like the [[Brawler]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can fare pretty well if you are able to afford them. **Later on, towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies can also be effective against '''Abnormal Bosses''' as they will spawn more frequently. Such towers include the [[Demoman]], [[Executioner]], [[Mortar]] and [[Shotgunner]]. ***Splash damage also ignores defense, making splash damage towers even more effective. **The [[Military Base]]'s units deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, making multiple Level 2 [[Military Base]]s very effective against this enemy. *Early game towers with defense dropping, like the [[Cryomancer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Pyromancer]] can be useful at both killing the '''Abnormal Boss''' and decreasing its defense. **Decreasing its defense is not required however, as the '''Abnormal Boss''' has a negligible amount of defense. **Multiple such towers, like the [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]] can also be used to slow it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} AbnormalBoss.png|Second version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) Abnormal Boss.png|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyAbnormalBoss.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Abnormal Boss''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator Trailer|'''Abnormal Boss''' in the game trailer.
